# Suraj Nandan

> Suraj Nandan is a full-stack and AI engineer from Kishanganj, India. He builds reliable web products and grounded AI systems end to end with React, Node.js, TypeScript and PostgreSQL, and studies Computer Science at SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Delhi NCR Campus (class of 2027). His portfolio is surajnandan.in, published as "The Nandan Review".

He is the Suraj Nandan with GitHub username SpaceWalkerr, LinkedIn /in/surajnandan and LeetCode SurajNandan (875+ problems solved). Contact: surajnandan78@gmail.com.

Recent: Campus Winner in ACG Pack A Pitch 2.0 (Technology & Engineering, 2026) with Aditya Idnani and Lavanya Saxena, for an AI-first pharmaceutical glass-vial inspection concept.

## Case studies

- [Knot.ai](https://surajnandan.in/projects/knot-ai): an adaptive, spoken AI interview panel whose report can only quote the candidate; interview control lives in a deterministic proxy, not a prompt.
- [Hospitality.ai](https://surajnandan.in/projects/hospitality-ai): an insurance-aware hospital and treatment navigator with source-verified policy citations and deterministic cost ranking (GE HealthCare Precision Care Challenge 2026).
- [CardBridge](https://surajnandan.in/projects/cardbridge): a card-discount marketplace whose escrow state machine, KYC tiers and access rules are enforced in PostgreSQL.
- [Job Scheduler](https://surajnandan.in/projects/job-scheduler): a distributed job scheduler on PostgreSQL with SKIP LOCKED claiming and six hand-built scheduling data structures.
- [GigShield](https://surajnandan.in/projects/gigshield): parametric income protection for delivery riders, built by a team of three.
